description.en: A design review skill for screens that look AI-generated, and the pages to try it on.
description.zh: 给「一看就是 AI 写的」界面做设计返工的技能，附带两个专门用来练手的反面示例页。

description.en: Audits a screen that looks AI-generated, sets a design direction from the product itself, then fixes it in nine passes: spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals, motion. Screenshots and measuring use the Chrome or Edge already installed, so there is nothing else to install. Works offline, edits only workspace files, and asks before any paid image generation.
description.zh: 审计「像 AI 生成」的界面，从产品本身推出设计方向，再按九道 pass 逐层修：间距、颜色、图标、文案、字体、布局、细节、视觉、动效。截图与测量都用机器上已有的 Chrome/Edge，不需要额外安装；离线可用，只改工作区文件，付费出图前一定先问。
